summary: Sends the server OK/ready request for the current session object. If the session phase stored at this+0x3FC4 is in the active range (1-2), the session immediately marks itself ready via NetComm_SetSelfAsReady(-1). Otherwise it encodes a progress-bar event (type 4, subtype 3) using the session time (dbl_8AFEA0), creates the OK-indication texture via TextureCreationWrapper, and, when the session type (dword_7C569C) is not the server type 5, sanitizes and writes a 'sending server overflow' debug message. Called by SessionScoringUpdate.

operations.description: Read session phase from this+0x3FC4 and branch when it is greater than 0 and at most 2 (active phase).
On the active-phase path, return NetComm_SetSelfAsReady(-1) to mark the session self as ready.
Load session time from global dbl_8AFEA0 into a local.
Encode progress-bar event ProgressBarEventEncode(4, 3, 0, 0, LODWORD(v3), 1) using the low dword of the session time.
Create the OK-indication texture: TextureCreationWrapper(texture_buffer, 2, -1, -1), result stored as the fallback return value.
Branch on session type dword_7C569C being different from 5 (non-server session) before debug logging.
Sanitize the source-device-path string: StringSplitLoop(1, aDDevF119992002_1, 4371), result stored in the return value slot.
When StringSplitLoop returned truthy, return DebugLogWrite(&dword_8AD25C, aSendingServerO) to emit the 'sending server overflow' message.
Fall through returning the last call result when no early return was taken.

unresolved: Constants have unexplained semantics: NetComm_SetSelfAsReady(-1) sentinel, TextureCreationWrapper dimensions (-1, -1), and StringSplitLoop arguments (1, aDDevF119992002_1, 4371).
Globals aErr (0x005C5F90) and aOk (0x005C5F94) appear in the packet but not in the decompiled body; likely reached through code paths the decompiler folded away.
dbl_8AFEA0 is read as a double but only its low dword is passed to ProgressBarEventEncode.
